Name: The Nameless Vestibule
Author: Herolin0027
Description:
[b][size=5]The Nameless Vestibule / 无名门厅[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]

The Nameless Vestibule adds a hidden ten-portal hub to the Bus Tunnel. After restoring power to the central switchboard, players can access nine independent farm realms and one expanded year-round greenhouse.

Each realm is saved as an independent location. Crops, trees, chests, machines, grass, debris, and other placed objects are stored separately from the main farm and from the other realms.

The mod supports English and Simplified Chinese.


[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]

1. Install Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.1 or later.
2. Download and extract NamelessVestibule.zip.
3. Place the complete NamelessVestibule folder in Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

After installation, manifest.json and NamelessVestibule.dll should be located directly inside the NamelessVestibule folder.


[b][size=4]How to start[/size][/b]

Enter the Bus Tunnel and look for the hidden blue-light door on the right side of the north wall.

Inside the Vestibule, inspect the central switchboard and provide:

• 1 Battery Pack
• 5 Iron Bars
• 2 Refined Quartz

After restoring power, all ten portals become available. Inspecting the switchboard again opens the portal directory and the Portal Scepter shop.

The Portal Scepter costs 2,000,000g by default. Hold it and press the normal Use Tool button to open the destination menu. The price and repair requirements can be adjusted through Generic Mod Config Menu or config.json.


[b][size=4]Main features[/size][/b]

• A hidden central hub with ten numbered portals.
• Eight independent realms based on the vanilla farm layouts.
• An Everlasting Seasons Farm based on the complete Four Corners Farm layout.
• A Bountiful Greenhouse with a 36 × 28 central soil area, providing 1,008 tillable tiles.
• Crops can grow year-round in the Everlasting Seasons Farm and Bountiful Greenhouse.
• Independent location data for crops, chests, machines, trees, grass, and debris.
• A purchasable Portal Scepter with mouse, keyboard, and controller support.
• Original map exits return directly to the corresponding portal.
• Return Scepter, Warp Totems, and Obelisks retain their normal destinations.
• English and Simplified Chinese language support.
• The mod does not replace or modify any original game files.


[b][size=4]The ten portals[/size][/b]

1. Standard Farm
2. Riverland Farm
3. Forest Farm
4. Hill-top Farm
5. Wilderness Farm
6. Four Corners Farm
7. Beach Farm
8. Meadowlands Farm
9. Everlasting Seasons Farm
10. Bountiful Greenhouse


[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]

Required:

• Stardew Valley 1.6
• SMAPI 4.1 or later

Optional:

• Generic Mod Config Menu

Generic Mod Config Menu is only needed for changing settings through an in-game menu. The mod can run without it.


[b][size=4]Updating[/size][/b]

Close the game and replace the old NamelessVestibule folder with the folder from the new download.

Version 1.0.0 uses stable IDs for all ten added realms and does not intentionally remove or migrate existing crops, chests, machines, trees, or other placed objects.


[b][size=4]Uninstalling[/size][/b]

Before uninstalling, collect valuable items from all ten mod locations and make sure every player has returned to a vanilla location.

Save and exit the game, then delete the NamelessVestibule folder.


[b][size=4]中文说明[/size][/b]

《无名门厅》在公交隧道中增加了一扇隐藏入口。修复门厅中央控制终端后，玩家可以通过十扇传送门进入九块独立农场地界和一座扩建温室。

每个地点均独立保存。作物、树木、箱子、机器、草、杂物和其他放置物品不会与主农场或其他地界混在一起。


[b][size=4]安装[/size][/b]

1. 安装《星露谷物语》1.6 和 SMAPI 4.1 或更高版本。
2. 下载并解压 NamelessVestibule.zip。
3. 将完整的 NamelessVestibule 文件夹放入 Stardew Valley/Mods。
4. 通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。


[b][size=4]开始游玩[/size][/b]

前往公交隧道，调查北墙靠右的蓝灯隐藏门。

进入门厅后，调查中央控制终端并提交：

• 电池组 × 1
• 铁锭 × 5
• 精炼石英 × 2

修复完成后，十扇门会同时通电。再次调查控制终端可以查看十门目录，并以默认 2,000,000 金购买“门扉权杖”。

手持门扉权杖并按原版“使用工具”键，即可打开目的地菜单。维修材料和权杖价格可以通过 Generic Mod Config Menu 或 config.json 调整。


[b][size=4]主要功能[/size][/b]

• 十扇编号传送门和独立中央门厅。
• 八块采用原版农场布局的独立地界。
• 完整采用原版四角农场布局的恒季农场。
• 中央耕地为 36 × 28、共 1008 格的丰饶温室。
• 恒季农场与丰饶温室均支持全年种植。
• 作物、箱子、机器、树木、草和杂物分别保存。
• 门扉权杖支持鼠标、键盘和手柄。
• 地图原有出口会直接返回对应门前。
• 回程魔杖、传送图腾和方尖碑保持原版目的地。
• 支持英文和简体中文。
• 不替换或修改任何原版游戏文件。


[b][size=4]十扇门[/size][/b]

1. 标准农场
2. 河边农场
3. 森林农场
4. 山顶农场
5. 荒野农场
6. 四角农场
7. 海滩农场
8. 草原农场
9. 恒季农场
10. 丰饶温室


[b][size=4]升级与卸载[/size][/b]

升级前关闭游戏，使用新下载中的 NamelessVestibule 文件夹替换旧文件夹。

卸载前，请先取走十个 Mod 地点中的贵重物品，并让所有玩家返回原版地点。保存并退出游戏后，再删除 NamelessVestibule 文件夹。


[b][size=4]Credits[/size][/b]
